description: Retrieves component usage analytics for a specified Figma library file (identified by `file_key`), with data groupable by 'component' or 'file'.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for retrieving component usage analytics for a Figma library.

cursor.description: Opaque string for pagination to fetch the next page of data, obtained from a previous response.
cursor.title: Cursor

file_key.description: Unique identifier (key) of the Figma library file. Must be a published library file from an Enterprise plan organization.
file_key.title: File Key

group_by.description: Dimension to group analytics data, affecting the response `rows` structure. Use 'component' to see per-component usage stats, or 'file' to see which files use the library.
group_by.title: Group By

inputSchema.title: GetLibraryAnalyticsComponentUsageDataRequest

name: get_library_analytics_component_usage_data

GetLibraryAnalyticsComponentUsageDataRes.description: Component usage analytics for a Figma library, including usage rows and pagination.

data.description: The analytics results, including usage rows and pagination information.
data.title: Data

GetLibraryAnalyticsComponentUsageDataRes.title: GetLibraryAnalyticsComponentUsageDataResponse

Model.description: Container for the list of analytics data rows and pagination details.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page; present if `next_page` is true.
cursor.title: Cursor

next_page.description: Indicates if more analytics data is available on a subsequent page.
next_page.title: Next Page

rows.description: Array of analytics data rows; objects are `Row` or `Row1` based on the request's `group_by` parameter.
rows.title: Rows

Model.title: Model

Row.description: Analytics data for one item when results are grouped by 'component'.

component_key.description: Unique and stable identifier of the component.
component_key.title: Component Key

component_set_key.description: Unique and stable identifier of the component set, if applicable.
component_set_key.title: Component Set Key

component_set_name.description: Name of the component set, if applicable.
component_set_name.title: Component Set Name

files_using.description: Number of distinct files where this component is used.
files_using.title: Files Using

teams_using.description: Number of distinct teams using this component.
teams_using.title: Teams Using

usages.description: Total instances of this component used across the organization.
usages.title: Usages

Row.title: Row

Row1.description: Analytics data for one item when results are grouped by 'file'.

file_name.description: Name of the file using components from the library.
file_name.title: File Name

team_name.description: Name of the team owning or accessing this file.
team_name.title: Team Name

usages.description: Total component instances from the library used within this file.
usages.title: Usages

workspace_name.description: Name of the workspace this file belongs to, if applicable.
workspace_name.title: Workspace Name

Row1.title: Row1
